cases.sentence: ___ должны были происходить на большом четырехверстном эллиптической форме кругу пред беседкой.
cases.translation: The races were to take place on a large four-verst elliptical track in front of the pavilion.
cases.explain: «Скачки» is the subject of «должны были происходить», so it stands in the Nominative case.

cases.sentence: На этом кругу были устроены девять ___.
cases.translation: On this circuit nine obstacles had been arranged.
cases.explain: The quantity word «девять» governs the Genitive plural of the counted noun, hence «препятствий».

cases.sentence: Первое препятствие — запруженная река в три ___ шириною.
cases.translation: The first obstacle was a dammed river, three arshins wide.
cases.explain: After the numeral «три» (three), the counted noun takes the Genitive singular, hence «аршина».

cases.sentence: Он легко обошел трех, и впереди его оставался только рыжий гладиатор ___.
cases.translation: He easily passed three riders, and ahead of him only Mahotin's chestnut Gladiator remained.
cases.explain: «Гладиатор Мохотина» (Mahotin's Gladiator) expresses possession, requiring the Genitive «Мохотина».

cases.sentence: Он вдруг увидал почти под ногами своей лошади ___, который барахтался с Дианой на той стороне реки.
cases.translation: He suddenly saw, almost under his horse's feet, Kuzovlev, who was floundering with Diana on the other side of the river.
cases.explain: The verb «увидал» (saw) is transitive, taking a direct object in the Accusative for an animate noun, hence «Кузовлева».

cases.sentence: Он намеревался перейти большой барьер позади ___.
cases.translation: He intended to clear the big barrier behind Mahotin.
cases.explain: The preposition «позади» (behind) governs the Genitive case, hence «Мохотина».

cases.sentence: Государь и весь двор и толпы народа все смотрели на ___.
cases.translation: The Emperor, the whole court, and crowds of people all watched them.
cases.explain: The preposition «на» (at) governs the Accusative case, giving the pronoun form «них».

cases.sentence: Фру-Фру стала приближаться к Мохотину с самой выгодной ___.
cases.translation: Frou-Frou began drawing near Mahotin from the most advantageous side.
cases.explain: The preposition «с» (from) governs the Genitive case, hence «стороны».

cases.sentence: Вронский стал слышать ближе сап и скок ___.
cases.translation: Vronsky began to hear the panting and hoofbeats of Gladiator drawing closer.
cases.explain: «Скок гладиатора» (Gladiator's gallop) expresses possession, requiring the Genitive «гладиатора».

cases.translation: He was galloping up to the Irish bank.
cases.explain: The preposition «к» (toward) governs the Dative case, hence «банкетке».

cases.translation: Mahotin, at a swift gallop, passed by.
cases.explain: The preposition «на» expressing a state/manner takes the Prepositional case, hence «скаку».

cases.translation: Vronsky pulled the horse by the rein.
cases.explain: «Тянул» (pulled) is a transitive verb taking a direct object in the Accusative, hence «лошадь».

reading.ru: Всех офицеров скакало семнадцать человек.
reading.question: How many officers took part in the race?
reading.correct: Seventeen
reading.explain: The text states that seventeen officers rode in the race.

reading.ru: На этом кругу были устроены девять препятствий.
reading.question: How many obstacles were arranged on the course?
reading.correct: Nine
reading.explain: Nine obstacles had been set up on the circuit.

reading.ru: ирландская банкетка, состоящая, одно из самых трудных препятствий, из вала, утыканного хворостом, за которым невидная для лошади была еще канава.
reading.question: Why was the Irish bank considered one of the hardest obstacles?
options: It hid a ditch beyond a brush-covered mound, invisible to the horse
It was the tallest of all obstacles
It required jumping twice in a row without pause
It was located right before the finish line
reading.correct: It hid a ditch beyond a brush-covered mound, invisible to the horse
reading.explain: The Irish bank was a mound stuck with brushwood, behind which was a ditch invisible to the horse, requiring two obstacles to be cleared as one.

reading.ru: Но начинались скачки не с круга, а за сто сажен в стороне от него, и на этом расстоянии было первое препятствие — запруженная река в три аршина шириною, которую ездоки по произволу могли перепрыгивать или переезжать вброд.
reading.question: Where did the race actually begin, and what was the first obstacle?
options: A hundred sazhens from the circuit, at a dammed river riders could jump or ford
Directly at the pavilion, with the Irish bank first
At the stables, with no obstacles for the first mile
At the finish line, working backward
reading.correct: A hundred sazhens from the circuit, at a dammed river riders could jump or ford
reading.explain: The race started a hundred sazhens away from the circuit, where the first obstacle was a dammed river that riders could jump or cross by fording.

reading.ru: Раза три ездоки выравнивались, но каждый раз высовывалась чья-нибудь лошадь, и нужно было заезжать опять сначала.
reading.question: Why did the start get delayed several times?
options: Some rider's horse kept jumping the line early
Two riders collided at the start
reading.correct: Some rider's horse kept jumping the line early
reading.explain: Riders lined up about three times, but each time some horse pushed ahead, requiring a restart.

reading.ru: Знаток пускания, полковник Сестрин, начинал уже сердиться, когда, наконец, в четвертый раз крикнул «Пошел!» и ездоки тронулись.
reading.question: Who finally gave the starting signal, and on which attempt?
options: Colonel Sestrin, on the fourth attempt
The Emperor himself, on the first attempt
Vronsky's trainer, on the third attempt
An unnamed official, on the fifth attempt
reading.correct: Colonel Sestrin, on the fourth attempt
reading.explain: Colonel Sestrin, the expert starter, growing annoyed, finally shouted "Go!" on the fourth try.

reading.ru: Взволнованная и слишком нервная Фруфру потеряла первый момент, и несколько лошадей взяли с места прежде ее.
reading.question: What happened to Frou-Frou at the very start?
options: She was too nervous and lost the first moment, letting several horses take off before her
She bolted ahead of everyone instantly
She refused to move at all
reading.correct: She was too nervous and lost the first moment, letting several horses take off before her
reading.explain: Being agitated and overly nervous, Frou-Frou lost the initial moment, and several horses started before her.

reading.ru: Но еще не доскакивая реки, Вронский, изо всех сил сдерживая, влекшую в поводья лошадь, легко обошел трех, и впереди его оставался только рыжий гладиатор Мохотина, ровно и легко отбивавший задом пред самым Вронским.
reading.question: How many riders had Vronsky passed before reaching the river, and who remained ahead?
options: Three riders passed; only Mahotin's Gladiator remained ahead
None passed; he was in last place
All riders passed; he led the race
Two riders passed; Diana remained ahead
reading.correct: Three riders passed; only Mahotin's Gladiator remained ahead
reading.explain: Before reaching the river, Vronsky easily passed three riders, leaving only Mahotin's chestnut Gladiator ahead of him.

reading.ru: Гладиатор и Диана подходили вместе и почти в один и тот же момент раз-раз поднялись над рекой и перелетели на другую сторону.
reading.question: What happened as Gladiator and Diana reached the river?
options: They rose together and flew over to the other side almost simultaneously
They both stopped short of the water
reading.correct: They rose together and flew over to the other side almost simultaneously
reading.explain: Gladiator and Diana approached together and, almost at the same moment, rose over the river and flew to the other side.

reading.ru: Кузовлёв пустил поводье после прыжка, и лошадь полетела с ним через голову.
reading.question: What went wrong for Kuzovlev at the river?
options: He released the rein after the jump and was thrown over his horse's head
His horse refused the jump entirely
He fell asleep in the saddle
His saddle came loose before the jump
reading.correct: He released the rein after the jump and was thrown over his horse's head
reading.explain: Kuzovlev let go of the rein after the jump, and his horse flew over with him, throwing him over its head.

reading.ru: Но Фру-Фру, как падающая кошка, сделала на прыжке усилие ногами и спиной, и, миновав лошадь, понеслась дальше.
reading.question: How did Frou-Frou avoid colliding with Kuzovlev's fallen horse?
options: Like a falling cat, she twisted her legs and back in mid-jump to avoid it
She stopped completely before the obstacle
She jumped an entirely different path
reading.correct: Like a falling cat, she twisted her legs and back in mid-jump to avoid it
reading.explain: Like a falling cat, Frou-Frou made an effort with her legs and back mid-jump, avoided the horse, and dashed on.

reading.ru: После реки Вронский овладел вполне лошадью и стал удерживать ее, намереваясь перейти большой барьер позади Мохотина и уже на следующей, беспрепятственной дистанции, соженив двести, попытаться обойти его.
reading.question: What was Vronsky's plan after clearing the river?
options: To hold Frou-Frou back and clear the big barrier behind Mahotin
To slow down and let others pass
reading.correct: To hold Frou-Frou back and clear the big barrier behind Mahotin
reading.explain: After the river, Vronsky fully mastered his horse and held her back, intending to take the big barrier just behind Mahotin.

reading.ru: Большой барьер стоял пред самой царской беседкой. Государь и весь двор и толпы народа все смотрели на них.
reading.question: Where was the big barrier located, and who was watching?
options: Right before the imperial pavilion, watched by the Emperor and the court
Behind the stables, unseen by anyone
reading.correct: Right before the imperial pavilion, watched by the Emperor and the court
reading.explain: The big barrier stood right in front of the imperial pavilion, watched by the Emperor, the whole court, and crowds.

reading.ru: Гладиатор поднялся, не стукнув ничем, взмахнул коротким хвостом и исчез из глаз Вронского.
reading.question: How did Gladiator clear the big barrier?
options: Cleanly, without touching anything, then vanished from Vronsky's sight
He knocked down part of the barrier
He refused and had to be pulled over
reading.correct: Cleanly, without touching anything, then vanished from Vronsky's sight
reading.explain: Gladiator rose without knocking anything, flicked his short tail, and disappeared from Vronsky's view.

reading.ru: Разгоряченная шедшим впереди гладиатором, лошадь поднялась слишком рано пред барьером и стукнула о него задним копытом.
reading.question: What mistake did Frou-Frou make at the big barrier?
options: She rose too early and struck the barrier with a hind hoof
She refused to jump at all
She threw Vronsky from the saddle
reading.correct: She rose too early and struck the barrier with a hind hoof
reading.explain: Excited by Gladiator ahead of her, she rose too soon before the barrier and struck it with a hind hoof.

reading.ru: В то самое мгновение, как Вронский подумал о том, что надо теперь обходить Мохотина, сама Фру-Фру, поняв уже то, что он подумал, безо всякого поощрения, значительно наддала и стала приближаться к Мохотину с самой выгодной стороны, со стороны веревки.
reading.question: How did Frou-Frou seem to anticipate Vronsky's intentions?
options: She sped up on her own, as if understanding his thought to overtake Mahotin
She slowed down, waiting for his command
reading.correct: She sped up on her own, as if understanding his thought to overtake Mahotin
reading.explain: The moment Vronsky thought of passing Mahotin, Frou-Frou, seeming to understand, sped up without urging and moved toward the advantageous side.

reading.ru: Но пред препятствием, к которому они подходили, Вронский, чтобы не идти большой круг, стал работать поводьями и быстро на самом Косогоре обошел Мохотина.
reading.question: Where did Vronsky finally overtake Mahotin?
reading.correct: At the slope (Kosogor)
reading.explain: Working the reins to avoid a wide circle, Vronsky quickly passed Mahotin right at the slope, the Kosogor.

reading.ru: Вронский вел скачку. То самое, что он хотел сделать и что ему советовал Корт, и теперь он был уверен в успехе.
reading.question: How did Vronsky feel once he was leading the race?
options: Confident of success, having followed the trainer Cord's advice
Anxious that Mahotin would soon retake the lead
Ready to slow down and settle for second place
reading.correct: Confident of success, having followed the trainer Cord's advice
reading.explain: He was now leading the race, exactly as he wanted and as Cord had advised, and he felt sure of success.

reading.ru: Он подскакивал к ирландской банкетке. Вместе с Фруфру он еще издалека видел эту банкетку, и вместе им обоим, ему и лошади, пришло мгновенное сомнение.
reading.question: What happened as Vronsky and Frou-Frou approached the Irish bank?
options: Both horse and rider felt a moment of doubt seeing it from afar
Vronsky closed his eyes and let her jump blindly
They took a detour around it
reading.correct: Both horse and rider felt a moment of doubt seeing it from afar
reading.explain: Seeing the bank from a distance, both he and the horse experienced a moment's hesitation together.

reading.ru: «Браво, Вронский!» — послышались ему голоса кучки людей. Он знал его полка и приятелей, которые стояли у этого препятствия.
reading.question: Who cheered Vronsky's successful jump over the Irish bank?
options: A group from his regiment and his friends
reading.correct: A group from his regiment and his friends
reading.explain: Voices of a small group he recognized as his regiment's men and friends shouted "Bravo, Vronsky!" at that obstacle.

reading.ru: Но в это самое время Вронский к ужасу своему почувствовал, что, не поспев за движением лошади, он сам, не понимая как, сделал скверное, непростительное движение, опустившись на седло.
reading.question: What critical mistake did Vronsky make near the final ditch?
options: He failed to move with the horse and sat down badly in the saddle
He pulled the reins too hard
He looked back at Mahotin and lost balance
reading.correct: He failed to move with the horse and sat down badly in the saddle
reading.explain: To his horror, not keeping pace with the horse's movement, he made an unforgivable, clumsy motion, sitting down wrong in the saddle.

reading.ru: Вронский касался одной ногой земли, и его лошадь валилась на эту ногу. Он едва успел выпростать ногу, как она упала на один бок, тяжело хрипя, и делая, чтобы подняться, тщетные усилия своей тонкую потную шеей, она затрепыхалась на земле у его ног, как подстрелянная птица.
reading.question: What happened to Frou-Frou immediately after Vronsky's mistake?
options: She fell heavily onto her side, breathing hard
She regained her stride and kept running
She threw Vronsky off cleanly and ran on alone
She stopped calmly and stood still
reading.correct: She fell heavily onto her side, breathing hard
reading.explain: Vronsky's foot touched the ground and the horse fell onto that side; she collapsed onto her side, breathing heavily.

reading.ru: «А-а-а!» — промычал Вронский, схватившись за голову. «А-а-а! Что я сделал?» — прокричал он. «И проигранная скачка, и своя вина постыдная, непростительная! Эта несчастная, милая, погубленная лошадь! А-а-а! Что я сделал?»
reading.question: What was Vronsky's reaction upon realizing what had happened?
options: Anguish, blaming himself for losing the race and ruining his beloved horse
Relief that he hadn't been badly hurt
Anger directed at Mahotin for cheating
Indifference, since he expected to lose anyway
reading.correct: Anguish, blaming himself for losing the race and ruining his beloved horse
reading.explain: He cried out in anguish, grabbing his head, blaming himself for the shameful, unforgivable fault and for ruining his beloved horse.

reading.ru: Лошадь сломала себе спину и решено было ее пристрелить.
reading.question: What was the horse's fate after the fall?
options: She had broken her back and it was decided to shoot her
She was sold to another rider
reading.correct: She had broken her back and it was decided to shoot her
reading.explain: The horse had broken her back, and it was decided that she must be shot.

reading.ru: Он повернулся и, не подняв соскочившей из головы фуражки, пошел прочь от гипподрома, сам не зная куда.
reading.question: What did Vronsky do immediately after the accident?
options: He walked away from the hippodrome without picking up his fallen cap, not knowing where he was going
He mounted another horse and continued racing
He rushed to find Anna in the pavilion
He demanded to speak with Mahotin
reading.correct: He walked away from the hippodrome without picking up his fallen cap, not knowing where he was going
reading.explain: He turned and walked away from the hippodrome, not even picking up his fallen cap, not knowing where he was going.
